requested_by: user directive: benchmark leading MES systems if not already covered
scope: Industrial / M07 manufacturing MES planning benchmark
source_policy: official_vendor_sources_only_for_observed_strengths; oyatie_gap and improve_upon are repo-local inferences
claim_boundary: This artifact establishes competitor/category awareness and planning benchmarks. It does not prove feature parity, runtime maturity, or production readiness.

observed_strengths: MES family for production visibility, control, and optimization across enterprise operations.
Links enterprise systems with automated manufacturing equipment and reflects design, engineering, and process data on the factory floor.
Covers discrete, process, electronics, medical-device, pharma, and semiconductor execution variants.
oyatie_adopt: Model M07 manufacturing as vertical-specific execution variants, not one generic factory module.
Bind work-order execution to engineering/process data and automated-equipment adapters.
oyatie_improve_upon: Expose ISA-95/OPC UA/Workflow/Ontology contracts as vendor-neutral interfaces from day one.
Keep regulated eDHR/eBR and quality evidence as auditable Oyatie evidence bundles instead of opaque suite state.

competitors.vendor: Rockwell Automation Plex Smart Manufacturing Platform
observed_strengths: Cloud smart-manufacturing platform covering MES, QMS, ERP, SCP, connected worker, production monitoring, automation/orchestration, APM, and finite scheduling.
Positions manufacturing operations as connected, automated, tracked, and analyzed in one platform.
oyatie_adopt: Treat MES, quality, production monitoring, scheduling, and connected-worker flows as one coordinated operator workflow surface.
Track production execution, quality escape prevention, and finite-schedule changes as first-class audit events.
oyatie_improve_upon: Avoid platform lock-in by keeping MES state portable through open event schemas and Workflow/Ontology boundaries.
Separate ERP/accounting ownership from MES execution so plant-floor defects cannot silently mutate financial ledgers.

observed_strengths: Cloud MES/MOM on SAP BTP connecting shop floor and top floor.
AI-guided KPIs and analytics, coordinated execution with planning and logistics, and skills/certification tracking integrated with SAP SuccessFactors.
Implementation starter kits and reusable service registration through SAP Digital Manufacturing documentation.
oyatie_adopt: Benchmark MES against ERP, logistics, HR-skills/certification, and analytics integration, not only shop-floor dispatch.
Require implementation starter fixtures for M07 plant onboarding and operator journeys.
oyatie_improve_upon: Make non-SAP ERP and HR adapters first-class through Workflow/Ontology rather than assuming an SAP estate.
Keep AI recommendations advisory until tied to explicit operator approvals and safety guardrails.

competitors.vendor: Dassault Systemes DELMIA Apriso / DELMIA MES
observed_strengths: MES as a core DELMIA MOM component aligned to ISA-95 production capabilities.
Coordinates people, processes, equipment, tooling, and materials globally with real-time operations monitoring and reporting.
Offers low-code configurability, global multi-plant governance, virtual twin integration, and broad ERP connection coverage.
oyatie_adopt: Use ISA-95 as the vocabulary for M07 production, quality, inventory/material, and equipment integration.
Treat multi-plant rollout governance and process standardization as first-class product depth.
oyatie_improve_upon: Keep virtual-twin and simulation hooks optional and inspectable rather than making them a closed platform dependency.
Provide lighter-weight plant templates in Workflow Studio for small manufacturers before full global MOM rollout.

observed_strengths: Hybrid-cloud MES with composable frontline operator interface and modular deployment.
Combines MES with workflow management and connected-worker capabilities.
Emphasizes plant-network visibility, data ecosystem connection, yield, quality, productivity, OEE, capacity utilization, and standards-driven SCADA/MES/IIoT context.
oyatie_adopt: Make connected-worker tasks, work instructions, and exception handling native to Workflow Studio.
Require OEE, yield, quality, and capacity dashboards for M07 manufacturing readiness.
oyatie_improve_upon: Keep OT integration adapter-based and standards-driven so one SCADA or IIoT stack cannot dominate the architecture.
Make incremental deployment measurable with per-template evidence instead of broad transformation claims.

observed_strengths: MOM/MES for process, discrete, and mixed manufacturers.
Collects and analyzes plant data and manages highly automated, fast-moving processes as well as slower labor-intensive jobs.
oyatie_adopt: Support both automated high-throughput lines and labor-intensive cells in the same MES model.
Separate data collection, production execution, and analytics contracts so plants can phase adoption.
oyatie_improve_upon: Make slow/manual job execution ergonomic in the same UI quality bar as automated-line telemetry.
Prevent analytics dashboards from becoming the source of truth; execution events and audit chain remain canonical.

competitors.vendor: Tulip Composable MES / Frontline Operations Platform
observed_strengths: Composable, app-based MES for managing production and capturing, contextualizing, and visualizing production data.
Frontline operations emphasis with quality checkpoints, work-order transactions, material replenishment workflows, inspection trends, takt-time alerts, and batch-review exceptions.
oyatie_adopt: Make operator app composition and station-level workflows first-class in Workflow Studio.
Prioritize frontline UX for work instructions, exceptions, replenishment, inspection, and batch review.
oyatie_improve_upon: Pair composability with governance: every operator app must declare data classes, safety ceiling, and audit-chain effects.
Use generated fixtures and simulator playback to keep low-code plant apps testable before shop-floor rollout.

benchmark_dimensions_required_for_M07: ISA-95 production, quality, inventory/material, maintenance, labor, and equipment vocabulary
OPC UA / SCADA / historian adapters with OT-network isolation
work-order dispatch, execution, exception, rework, and completion lifecycle
OEE, yield, quality, scrap, downtime, takt, and capacity dashboards
connected-worker work instructions, certification checks, and supervisor approvals
traceability/genealogy, eDHR/eBR where regulated, and immutable audit evidence
multi-plant template rollout, versioning, rollback, and plant-local override governance
Workflow Studio operator UX for station-level task composition and guardrails
oyatie_gap: No machine-readable M07 manufacturing/MES PRD exists under specs/products yet.
Existing MES coverage is mostly prose in masterplan, team charter, and competitive-gap docs.
No validator currently enforces MES benchmark dimensions, ISA-95 coverage, OPC UA adapter boundaries, OEE telemetry, or connected-worker UX depth.

planned_actions.action: Create specs/products/industrial/manufacturing-mes.json with source-backed competitive rows and benchmark_dimensions_required_for_M07.
Add Workflow Studio templates for SOP execution, work-order dispatch, defect routing, quality inspection, material replenishment, and batch review.
Ship oya-check-industrial-mes-benchmark to fail M07 graduation when source refs, ISA-95 dimensions, OT boundary, OEE telemetry, and operator UX guardrails are absent.
